extracted.intended_audience: novelists, creative-writing students, literary critics, and serious readers interested in novel form
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and principles for understanding, evaluating, and producing novels—covering formal definitions, discourse modes, narrative structure, and qualities that make a novel 'work'. Intended to guide writers and critics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of the Novel (five requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: A novel is 'a (1) lengthy, (2) written, (3) prose, (4) narrative with a (5) protagonist.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All five elements are part of Smiley's working definition; use them as baseline criteria when deciding whether a work qualifies as a novel. 'Lengthy' implies sufficient space for development; 'prose' rules out verse-narratives; 'protagonist' implies a central figure whose arc justifies the length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Travel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of travel-as-discourse can provide movement, setting variety, and opportunities for reflection or change of perspective. Great novels often incorporate travel elements alongside other modes.

rubrics_metrics.name: History (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: History.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical discourse situates characters/events in wider temporal context and can provide depth and causality. Combining history with other modes deepens ambition and richness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biography (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Biography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biographical mode foregrounds life-story elements and character development; used well, it gives a sense of verisimilitude and sustained subjectivity within a novel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tale (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Tale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tale elements (plot-driven, folkloric, mythic) can clarify moral or structural arcs; mixing tale with other modes prevents the work from feeling one-dimensional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joke (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Joke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humor or joke-like interventions can shape tone, undercut seriousness, or create character voice; should be balanced with other modes to sustain depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gossip (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Gossip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gossip-mode supplies social texture, rumor, and communal voice; it can reveal social dynamics and indirectly characterize figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diary or Letter (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Diary or Letter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Epistolary or diaristic modes create intimacy of voice and subjective time; can be combined with other modes to vary perspective and reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confession (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Confession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confessional mode centers a subjective admission or moral reckoning; it affects voice, trust, and reader alignment with protagonist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Polemic (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Polemic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Polemic introduces argumentative, persuasive elements—ideological thrusts—into a novel; best used with care so the work remains artistically complex rather than didactic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essay (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Essay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essayistic passages allow digression, reflection, and explicit exploration of ideas; skillful novels weave essay elements without stalling narrative momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Epic (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Epic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Epic mode introduces large scale, sweeping temporal or geographical scope and elevated tone; can justify length and breadth when balanced with intimate modes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Romance (discourse mode)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of twelve discourse styles a novel may contain: Romance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Romance here indicates adventure/romantic plot traditions; inclusion influences plot priorities and expectations; when mixed with other modes it adds emotional stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range of Discourse Modes (multi-stylistic richness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Great novels contain many of the twelve discourse styles; 'range of "discourse modes" within a single work signals ambition and depth.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for multi-stylistic richness—novels that operate in only one mode are described as 'impoverished.' Use mode-mixing deliberately to add layers and sustain engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Single-Mode Operation
rubrics_metrics.description: A novel that operates in only one mode is impoverished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As an anti-pattern: relying solely on one discourse style reduces depth and ambition. Strive to incorporate complementary modes to enrich the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exposition (structural aspect)
rubrics_metrics.description: Exposition as a key aspect of novel structure (one element in Smiley's 'circle of the novel').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exposition should supply necessary background and character/world setup without overwhelming pacing. It's one part of the structural cycle moving toward action and climax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rising Action (structural aspect)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rising action as a key structural phase in the novel's circular relation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rising action develops conflict and complications; it must accumulate stakes and turning points that justify the novel's length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climax (structural aspect)
rubrics_metrics.description: Climax as a central structural moment in the novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Climax should be a turning point that resolves core conflicts or transforms the protagonist; it must feel earned by preceding action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Denouement (structural aspect)
rubrics_metrics.description: Denouement as the resolution phase in the novel's structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denouement ties up consequences and aftermath; it should provide closure proportionate to the novel's scope without unnecessary padding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Turning Points and Structural Moments
rubrics_metrics.description: Turning points and other structural moments are essential to the 'circle' of the novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and craft turning points that change direction or deepen stakes; these moments structure narrative movement and justify narrative length.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Novel as Freedom (value claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel is 'perhaps the ultimate expression of freedom'—artistic, personal, political; reading novels develops ability to see multiple POVs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the novel as a space for expansive viewpoint and complexity. For creators: use the form to explore freedom of perspective and moral complexity rather than enforce narrow didacticism.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Novel as Subversive (value claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: Novel-reading 'incubates an ability to see multiple points of view, thus leading to a more liberal view of the world.' The form itself is politically and morally formative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the novel's potential to challenge assumptions and cultivate empathy—this is a value to pursue in serious fiction, though not a formal requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustained Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: One of Smiley's markers for what makes a novel 'work': sustained engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A novel must sustain the reader's attention across its length through plot, character, language, or thematic interest. Failure to sustain engagement indicates structural or stylistic problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: A Protagonist Worth Following
rubrics_metrics.description: A protagonist who is worth the reader's time is essential to a working novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character investment justifies the novel's length; protagonists should present enough complexity, conflict, or fascination to merit prolonged attention. Anti-pattern: protagonists who do not develop or lack compelling stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length Sufficient for Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The novel should be of a length sufficient to allow the necessary development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Length is a criterion: a novel must be long enough for its ambitions. However, length must be earned—avoid arbitrary padding or unjustified brevity that truncates necessary development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prose (not verse) as Medium
rubrics_metrics.description: Smiley's definition requires prose rather than verse as the novel's medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This formal boundary excludes verse-narratives from Smiley's working category of 'novel.' Writers should choose prose to meet this definition, or be explicit if working in a hybrid form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length Must Be Earned (avoid arbitrary brevity/length)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length should be earned by content; 'arbitrary brevity OR length both fail.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anti-patterns: excessive padding to reach 'novel' length or truncating narrative so that development is incomplete. Each structural choice must justify the novel's scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meta-critical Caveat: Not a Strict Taxonomy
rubrics_metrics.description: Smiley's book is a discursive exploration rather than a strict set of rules—she 'doesn't actually deliver 13 well-defined "ways of looking" as the title suggests.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these criteria as flexible principles and prompts for reflection, not as inflexible checklists. The guidance is descriptive and heuristic rather than prescriptive legalistic rules.
